title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
reason: First state AG lawsuit holding an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident is frontier-shifting regulatory action.

sources.summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.

title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
reason: A major Ethereum upgrade risking breakage of up to 15,000 apps with audit findings and a near-term developer decision is significant protocol news.

sources.summary: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.
